posters.title: QR posters
posters.subtitle: Codes printed ahead of time, assigned once the shop is known.
posters.noAccess: This desk isn't visible with your role
posters.noAccessBody: Generating a batch, revoking a poster and preparing a mailing are reserved to the founder and the admins.
posters.generateHint: A hundred posters can go to the printer before anyone knows which shops will get them.
posters.labelHint: How you will recognise it later: "October print run", "Lyon tour".
posters.generatedBody: One page per code, ready to print.
posters.pdfLanguageHint: Independent from the interface language. Six languages only: the standard PDF fonts cannot write Japanese, Arabic, Russian or Chinese, and embedding a font that covers them would weigh several megabytes.
posters.pdfUnprintableBody: The chosen translation uses characters the standard PDF fonts cannot write. Pick another language rather than a PDF full of question marks.
posters.pdfPromise: Text refused: it promises a notification
posters.pdfPromiseBody: In-app notifications do not exist yet. Fix the translation before printing — found "{{word}}".
posters.pdfHeadline: Your turn, live on your phone.
posters.pdfAction: Scan this code: you see your place in the queue live, so you can step out for a coffee and keep an eye on it.
posters.pdfCodeLabel: QR damaged? Type this code instead
posters.letterBody:
FadeUp is the app where customers find a barber and follow the queue live from their phone.

Your shop has a page there that nobody has claimed yet. The enclosed poster carries a code that belongs to no shop.

Scan it: it takes you to your page. Claim it — it is free, and someone at FadeUp reviews your request — then open your queue. The poster attaches to it with a single scan, and customers who scan it see your queue live: they can wait outside without losing their turn.
posters.letterProofHeading: What we already measure on your listing
posters.letterCallToAction: Scan the QR on this letter, or the one on the poster: both carry the same code. It takes you to your page; the poster only attaches to your shop once your queue is open.
posters.proofViewsAllTime: Listing views since it went live: {{value}}
posters.batchesHint: When, how many, and what became of each one.
posters.batchesEmpty: No batch has been generated yet.
posters.pickBatch: Open a batch to see its posters.
posters.postersEmpty: No poster in this batch for this filter.
posters.revokeBody: An assigned poster cannot be redirected: to give it to another shop, revoke it first, then assign it again.
posters.revokeReasonHint: Required — the server refuses a revocation without one.
posters.reassignBody: This poster was revoked. Assigning it again puts it back in service for the chosen location.
posters.locationsEmpty: No location you can assign a poster to.
posters.letterIntro: One envelope holds the letter and the poster, in a single PDF. The same code serves both.
posters.letterMarks: Preparing it marks the poster as gone by post to that prospect.
posters.letterOnlyFree: Only a free poster goes out by post.

posters.proofIncluded: The letter will carry these real figures:

salesDesk.publishBody: Publishing emails the professional the GDPR article 14 notice, makes the record public and puts the legal responsibility on FadeUp. The action is logged.
salesDesk.onboardingHint: Shared with moderation. The full handling lives on the application screen.
